name: Ura: Jinzai Haken Center
original_name: 裏　人材派遣センター
source:
Three girls are contacted from the temporary staff center. During the training period girls are being sexually harassed inside the company. After that they hope for a decent job, but is it really what expects them at a new workplace?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
临时工作人员中心联系了三名女孩。培训期间，女生在公司内遭到性骚扰。之后他们希望找到一份体面的工作，但这真的是他们在新工作场所所期望的吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
